name: support
title: Customer support resolution
description: Inbound support calls: issue type, resolution, escalation, follow-up.

fields.instructions: What main problem did the customer call about?
The agent resolved the customer's issue before the call ended.
The customer says they have contacted support about this same issue before.
The customer explicitly asks for a supervisor or manager.
How clearly did the agent acknowledge the customer's concern in words?
What follow-up did the agent agree to?

criteria.callback: Agent or customer will call back
criteria.ticket_opened: A ticket or case was created

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Contoso support. This call is recorded. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My internet keeps dropping every evening, it's really frustrating.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. Can I confirm the account holder's name and postcode?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, Priya Shah, postcode 560001.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I see a fault on your line. I have reset it remotely, please check now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It seems to be working. Will it stay stable?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If it drops again, call us and I will send an engineer. I have noted this on your case.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thanks. That was quick, I appreciate the help.

name: collections
title: Collections / payment reminder (compliance and outcomes)
description: Overdue payment reminder calls: disclosures, promise to pay, callbacks. Operational QA only.
notice: Operational QA only. Do not use outputs to automate account actions or legal escalation.

fields.instructions: The person on the call confirms they are the account holder.
The agent verified the customer's identity before mentioning the amount owed.
The agent read the required collections disclosure.
The customer explicitly commits to pay a specific amount or on a specific date.
Which amount did the customer promise to pay?
On which date did the customer promise to pay?
The customer says they dispute the debt or its amount.
What reason did the customer state for non-payment?
How professional was the agent's language?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Alex from Fabrikam Finance. This call may be recorded. Am I speaking with Mr Rao?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm calling about your overdue card payment of $320. Is this a good time to talk?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. I was travelling, I forgot to pay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. Could you pay the amount today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay it on 15 November. I will pay $320 by then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, I have noted a promise to pay $320 on 15 November. You will get an SMS reminder.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. Thanks for being polite about it.

name: sales_qualification
title: Sales lead qualification
description: Outbound or inbound sales: interest, budget, timeline, objections, next step.

fields.instructions: The prospect explicitly asks for a demo, quote or more information.
A budget or price range was stated by the prospect.
The prospect says they can make or approve the purchase.
When does the prospect say they plan to buy?
What main objection did the prospect state?
A next meeting or demo was confirmed with a specific date or time.
What follow-up date was agreed?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Sam from Northwind Software. Do you have a few minutes to talk about our CRM?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, briefly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What tool are you using today to manage customers?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Spreadsheets mostly. It's getting messy with a team of 25.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have a budget in mind and who decides on a purchase?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: About $5,000 a quarter, and I decide together with our CFO.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. Can we schedule a demo on 20 November with both of you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, send an invite to me.

name: appointments
title: Appointment booking and scheduling
description: Clinic, service or sales appointment calls. Scheduling only, no triage.
notice: Scheduling and call quality only. Do not use for triage, diagnosis or clinical decisions.

fields.instructions: What did the caller want to do?
A specific appointment date and time was confirmed on the call.
What appointment date was agreed?
The agent verified the caller's identity before sharing details.
The caller agreed to receive reminders.
What phone number did the caller give for contact?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, City Clinic appointments. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'd like to book a check-up for next week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly. Do you have a preferred day?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Tuesday 18 November, in the morning if possible.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have 10 am on 18 November. Shall I book it?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes please. You can reach me on 415-555-0166.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Booked for 18 November at 10 am. You will receive an SMS confirmation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thank you.

name: retention
title: Churn and retention (telecom, subscriptions)
description: Cancellation and retention calls: stated reason, offers made, outcome.

fields.instructions: The customer explicitly asks to cancel the service.
What main reason did the customer state for leaving?
The agent offered a discount, plan change or other incentive to stay.
The customer explicitly accepts the retention offer.
What was the final outcome?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Tailwind Mobile. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to cancel my plan. It's too expensive.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. May I ask what you pay now and what would feel right?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: $60 a month. Another provider offers $40.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can offer you a plan at $42 a month with the same data, for 12 months.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hmm, that's close. Okay, I will stay on that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done, the new plan starts next month. Anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, thanks for the offer.

name: retail_returns
title: Retail orders and returns
description: E-commerce support: order status, returns, refunds, delivery problems.

fields.instructions: What did the customer contact support about?
The customer explicitly asks for a refund.
What did the agent agree to provide?
The customer says this is a repeat problem.
The agent resolved the request before the call ended.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Welcome to Adventure Works orders. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My jacket arrived in the wrong size. Order 48213. I want to return it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem. Returns are free within 30 days. Would you like a refund or an exchange?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: An exchange for a large, please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have created a return label and will ship the large once we receive the jacket. It should arrive in about five days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Can you email the label to me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I have sent it to your email on file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Got it, thanks, that was easy.

name: qa_compliance
title: Agent QA and compliance coaching
description: Any contact-center call: greeting, disclosures, active listening, closing.

fields.instructions: The agent greeted the customer and stated the company name.
The agent told the customer the call is recorded.
The agent read the mandatory script or disclosure.
How well did the agent acknowledge the customer's stated concern?
The agent promised something outside policy, such as a guarantee.
The agent recapped next steps and asked if anything else was needed.
Which single area most needs coaching?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Litware Bank. This call is recorded for quality. My name is Dana.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'd like to check why I was charged a fee.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me verify you first. Please confirm your date of birth.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's 2 June 1985.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. The $12 fee is a monthly maintenance charge. I can waive it this time.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That would be great.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done. Is there anything else I can help with? Thank you for calling Litware Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, thank you.

name: auto_dealership
title: Automotive sales enquiry (cars / four-wheelers)
description: Inbound or outbound car enquiry calls: model interest, features, test drive booking, pricing and follow-up.

fields.instructions: What was the main reason for the call?
The customer named a specific car model or variant they are interested in.
The agent explained key features of the car the customer asked about.
The agent shared price, offers or finance options.
The customer asked for a test drive.
The agent confirmed a test drive booking.
Did the customer state when they plan to buy?
Did the customer explicitly say how they felt about the call?
What test drive date was agreed or requested?
Which phone number did the customer give for contact?
What budget or price figure did the customer mention?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Sunrise Motors. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'm looking at your new SUV models. Can you tell me about the features of the Aria?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. The Aria comes with a sunroof, six airbags, a 10 inch touchscreen and a hybrid engine option. Prices start at $28,500.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nice. My budget is around $30,000. Do you have any finance offers?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, we have 3.9 percent financing this month. Would you like to book a test drive?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes please, can I come on 14 November in the morning?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I have booked your test drive for 14 November at 10 am. Can I get a number to confirm by SMS?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's 415-555-0147. I'm planning to buy within two months.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, you will get a confirmation shortly. Anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that was really helpful, thank you.
